rv.q: For the audience, in turn, this production is a discombobulating experience in which it isn’t easy to keep track of all the narrative layers or to fully grasp what it means, yet it has a distinctive beauty and theatricality of its own.
Crouch has crafted a compelling reimagining, infused with a rough, melancholy magic that is as irresistible as it is quietly heartbreaking.
But there’s still a certain pathos that comes with leaving this space, knowing it’ll be quite some time before you see a Shakespeare play that hums with so much mischief and life.
